messages:
mike: quick design check — putting this here so we don't forget before the sprint demo. new API key modal prototype: users can 'Show secret' for 30s, then it auto-masks. want feedback on copy, accessibility, and abuse surface.

jess: this looks good visually. quick thought: 'Show secret' suggests permanence; maybe change CTA to 'Reveal temporarily' to set expectations? :thinking_face: 

tara: agree with jess. also keyboard flow: can you tab to the reveal button, press Space/Enter and have focus stay on the revealed secret? screenreader should announce "secret revealed" via aria-live.

anil: dev note — auto-masking after 30s easy enough. we also need to disable screenshots warning? can't prevent screenshots but can show a small callout: 'This value will only be shown once; copy it now.'

zoe: wording proposal for the small callout under the secret field: 
```
This key will only be visible briefly. Store it securely — we won’t show it again.
Expires: Never (unless you set a TTL)
```
I think we should make 'Expires' an inline toggle during creation to choose ephemeral vs persistent.

mike: nice. product question — what about scopes/permissions on create? current mock shows a multi-select but it's buried behind an 'Advanced' accordion. several users asked for scopes up-front.

jess: UX pov: surface most common scopes (read-only, embeddings) as chips first, then 'Show all permissions' secondary. reduces cognitive load.

tara: accessibility nit: chips should have clear focus outline and aria-pressed state. ensure color contrast meets AA — current purple on blue fails for 3 of 4 chips.

anil: noted. I'll hand the color tokens to design for contrast tweaks.

zoe: another thought on 'copy' affordance. when user clicks copy, we should show an ephemeral toast: 'Copied to clipboard — this key will not be shown again.' toast should have role=alert for SR users.

mike: +1. also we need a persistent audit link from the modal: 'View key activity' that opens the audit timeline in a new tab. massive ask from security customers.

jess: copy for danger modal when revoking keys: current text is 'Are you sure?'. too vague. suggest: 'Revoking this key will stop all applications using it immediately. This action is irreversible.' add list item: 'You can create a replacement key after revocation.'

tara: revocation modal accessibility: focus trap is required; also provide a keyboard shortcut to cancel (Esc) and confirm (Enter) and make primary CTA clearly labeled 'Revoke key'.

anil: small implementation detail: for ephemeral keys (TTL set), the UI should show upcoming deletion time in the keys list with a tooltip: 'Expires in 3 days — scheduled for 2026-04-01 15:00 UTC'. tooltip should be fetchable via API for integrations.

zoe: empty state suggestion for keys page when there are zero keys: instead of 'No keys yet', show a small step-by-step card: 1) create key 2) scope selection 3) copy secret. include a sample curl snippet to try: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_KEY>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/status
```
This helps devs onboard faster.

mike: love the sample snippet. let's ensure code block has a copy button and visible focus state for keyboard users.

jess: microcopy tweak for 'Show secret' tooltip: 'Visible for 30s. Do not share.' vs 'Only visible once' — which is more accurate? If we auto-mask after 30s but still store the key for future retrieval (we don't), copy should say 'visible once'. clarifying: our back-end will not allow retrieval after initial reveal, right?

anil: correct — we store only a hash. once created the full secret is not retrievable via API. so copy should be 'Visible only once'. update UI to reflect that (even if we unmask briefly for UX).

tara: then change aria-live announcement to: 'Secret revealed. This value will not be shown again.' make sure we don't include the secret in any logs or data-attributes where SR could pick it up accidentally.

zoe: legal-bot: heads up — for enterprise customers we need an explicit checkbox during creation: 'I understand this key grants access to production data'. legal prefers an explicit consent step for scoped production keys.

mike: OK — product decision: show consent checkbox when 'production' scope included. add copy: 'I understand this key can access production resources'. Requires scroll-to-accept for long policies? keep it short.

jess: design follow-ups:
- update chip colors for contrast
- CTA language -> 'Reveal secret' replaced with 'Reveal (shown once)'
- move permissions inline as chips with 'Advanced' expansion
- fatal modal copy for revoke updated
- add toast/alert roles for SR
- empty state step card + sample curl snippet

anil: dev follow-ups:
- ensure reveal button reachable via keyboard and exposes aria-pressed/aria-controls
- implement aria-live announcement and role=alert for copy toast
- avoid logging secrets and strip from telemetry
- expose expiry timestamp in keys API

mike: thanks all. I'll update the Figma and ping for a quick sync tomorrow. if anyone has final line-edits for microcopy drop them here. :thumbsup:

zoe: microcopy suggestion for create success toast: 'Key created — this value will be shown one time. Copy it now.'

jess: slight reword for revoke modal CTA: primary = 'Revoke key', secondary = 'Cancel'. include destructive color and aria-describedby pointing to the irreversible sentence.

mike: good. closing thread after Figma update.
